rationale: All deterministic functional checks pass: parsing rejects malformed, duplicate, and unknown IDs before storage changes; successful calls report exact changed and already-completed sets; repeated calls are idempotent; JSON remains banner-free; and text output renders the registered banner once. The implementation is straightforward and uses the existing atomic store writer, though the command always rewrites storage even when no status changes. Tests cover success, ordering, persistence, idempotence, rejection atomicity, and both output modes. The banner satisfies its mechanical constraints and clearly repeats BULK, but it reads as a dense stack of status slogans rather than a visually meaningful bulk-operation illustration. Uneven line widths and limited framing weaken hierarchy and composition. The diff also includes unrelated indentation regressions in the data-file and help blocks, reducing focus and polish.
